item.title: Check In at a Hotel
item.prompt_text: You arrive at a small hotel in Bukhara. Talk to the receptionist. Say hello and give your name, say you have a booking for two nights, ask what time breakfast is, and ask for the wifi password.
item.target_grammar: I have…; What time is…? What is…? questions
item.fluency_objective: Say each part of the check-in in one short, clear sentence.
item.pronunciation_objective: Say numbers and times clearly: 'two nights', 'seven o'clock'.
item.model_answer: Good evening! My name is Aziz Rakhimov. I have a booking for two nights. Here is my passport. What time is breakfast, please? From seven o'clock? Great. And what is the wifi password? Thank you very much. Where is my room?
item.model_opening: Good evening! My name is Aziz Rakhimov.
